Providers and commitments / F05

Commitments are not
one number.

The final prospectus states about $900.9B of compute and infrastructure commitments. That total mixes fixed tables, leases not yet commenced and post-quarter deals; it excludes variable arrangements; and about a fifth of it can be terminated or depends on conditions. Every value here is located in the filing text and unverified.

F05 / Commitment exposure

What the $900.9B is made of.

The issuer's own decomposition, checked: the five components add to 900.893 against a stated 900.9 (CHK-11 pass).

Components of the stated aggregate, USD billions, final prospectus. Bar length is scaled to the largest value in this table. Values located, unverified.

How this changed between versions

The S-1 left every amount blank. Amendment 1 stated ~$895.4B; Amendment 2 raised it to ~$900.9B, entirely from +$5.5B of post-quarter commitments, and cut the conditional share from $213.8B to $186.2B. It also first disclosed the $150–175B excluded estimate. See the lineage table →

What this view does not show

No delivery schedule, utilization, unit price, location or energy: the filing does not disclose them per arrangement. The conditional amount is not attributed to components. Nothing here is a solvency, exposure or risk score.
